Rule.errorCondition:

And

And [Source/type] != [Target/type]

And
;; source allows line breaks
[Source/type] == "String"
And FieldFilled(Source/linebreaksPermitted)

;; because target is not a string  (could be enumeration, ext. enumeration or custom field type)
([Target/type] != "String"
    Or
    ;; target is a string, but does not allow line breaks.
    ([Target/type] == "String"
        And FieldNotFilled(Target/linebreaksPermitted)))
